test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 10 February 2002 is a Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 17 March 2008?
solution: Given: **10 February 2002** was Sunday. Now, 2002 to 2008 = 6 Years (5 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year). And, In 6 Years = 1 Leap year and 5 Ordinary Year. So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days, And, 5 Ordinary Year has 5 odd days. Total odd days = 2 + 5 = 7.
